_doc: E4/E5 image-to-video bench (04 §6). Start/end frames are renders of the t2i bench prompts (same character) so identity can be judged across image and video. Frames under frames/ are produced in M0 close-out with the fp8 dev 20-step preset at the project Draft size and then frozen. Scores: identity (ArcFace FaceSim across frames, advisory), motion plausibility, end-frame reach (FLF tasks), artefacts, time.

tasks.prompt: she slowly turns to face the camera and lowers the compass, rain keeps falling, neon flickers, subtle handheld camera
tasks.expect: face and braids stay identical through the turn, cloak and compass preserved, no morphing of the sign

tasks.prompt: she walks toward the camera through the crowd, crowd moves naturally, camera holds still
tasks.expect: plausible gait and cloth motion, crowd parallax, identity kept while scale changes

tasks.prompt: she rises from the crouch and stands at the roof edge looking out, cloak moves in the wind
tasks.expect: reaches the end pose without a cut or morph, roofline and moon stay fixed

tasks.prompt: slow dolly push-in toward the chart table, lamp flame flickers, the captain nods once
tasks.expect: clean camera motion without geometry warping, two characters stable, lamp flicker plausible

tasks.prompt: she takes a breath, blinks, looks down and then back up at the camera, a single tear runs down her cheek
tasks.expect: natural blink and eye motion, no identity drift in a tight close-up, no teeth/mouth artefacts
